# Butler v0.0.15

## Change Log

- Kept active worker panels focused on currently relevant workers so completed
  or inactive rows do not clutter the App's active orchestration views. (#37)
- Hardened packaged App upgrade startup so upgraded installs can recover the
  Agent service path cleanly instead of stalling during first launch after an
  update. (#38)
- Stabilized Arch Linux App packaging with pacman package output and service
  metadata coverage for Arch-style installs. (#33)
- Reduced GitHub Release attachments by publishing only installable packages,
  manifests, the standalone Agent archive, and one consolidated
  `butler-0.0.15-SHA256SUMS` file instead of per-file checksum assets. (#39)
- Slimmed App packages by embedding only the bundled Agent archive and CLI
  launcher payload for each target platform, while keeping Ubuntu/Debian,
  Arch, RPM service installer, macOS, and standalone Agent release paths.
  (#39)
